full_judgment: 23. Therefore, in exercise of the power vested in this Court under Article 112 of the Constitution, the Deputy Commissioner, Sirajgonj, as the proper authority, shall cause to hold a local investigation to ascertain the actual area of the land used as graveyard and shall maintain status-quo in respect of graveyard to the extent mentioned in the schedule of the plaint being 2.50 (two and half decimals) or as may be found after investigation to be made, but in no case below 2.50 decimals (two and half decimals) and shall record the same as the same as graveyard in the khas khatian.
